# Basilin Joe — Personal Website

> Technology Lead & Cloud Solutions Architect with 7+ years specialising in Azure, AWS, DevOps, and Full Stack development.

## About

Basilin Joe is a Technology Lead at Experion Technologies based in Ernakulam, Kerala, India. His work focuses on enterprise-scale Azure cloud solutions, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD automation, and micro-frontend architecture.

- Languages: C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python
- Frameworks: .NET, Angular, React, Next.js, NestJS
- DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, SonarQube
